items.title: Pre-European contact leprosy in the Americas and its current persistence
items.note: Finds ancient M. lepromatosis in North and South America and compares it with later cases.

items.title: 4,000-year-old Mycobacterium lepromatosis genomes from Chile reveal long establishment of Hansen’s disease in the Americas
items.note: Identifies the organism in two people who lived in northern Chile about four thousand years ago.
